dist.src: McConnachie 2012 (AJ 144, 4; J/AJ/144/4), Andromeda XVIII: (m-M) 25.66 +0.13 -0.13, from resolved stellar populations (generally Cepheid, RR Lyrae or TRGB; also horizontal-branch level and main-sequence fitting); converted to a distance by Space Maps

alt_distances.reason: not used: larger uncertainty than the trgb distance

dist.src: UNGC (Karachentsev et al. 2013, J/AJ/145/101): Dist 1.36 Mpc, TRGB; UNGC gives no per-galaxy error and rounds to 0.01 Mpc (its Sec. 2 quotes 5-10 % for the TRGB, Cepheid and SN distances)

alt_distances.reason: not used: no published uncertainty, the trgb distance has one

dist.src: Cosmicflows-4 (Tully et al. 2023, ApJ 944, 94), table2 PGC 5056918: DMtrgb 25.53 ± 0.05, converted from the Cosmicflows-4 modulus by Space Maps (comoving, divided by 1 + Vcmb/c)

radius.src: half the catalogue major axis at the adopted distance
